summary: Master document digitization, OCR accuracy, and ISO 13028 standards. Learn to automate workflows and build searchable archives. Enroll in 5-day expert course.
lede: OCR training helps records professionals convert paper documents into searchable digital files. Learners explore image cleanup, templates for recognizing structured documents, and quality checks using character and word error rates, alongside metadata for organizing digitized records. The syllabus also introduces automated document classification and PDF/A formats for digital preservation.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals responsible for the lifecycle of organizational information and the technical implementation of digital archives.
modules: Hardware Architecture and Image Capture Optimization
OCR Engines and Character Recognition Fundamentals
Intelligent Document Processing and AI Integration
Quality Control and OCR Accuracy Metrics
Security, Privacy, and Compliance in Digitization
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of document management principles and basic familiarity with office productivity software. Experience with Windows-based file systems and an awareness of organizational record-keeping policies is recommended. No prior programming knowledge is required, though an interest in automation and data governance will be beneficial for the advanced OCR modules.
